name: Unyverse
detailed_description:
An Afrofuturistic Sci-Fi Action RPG Where Your Fists, Choices, and Inner Power Change the Fate of a Galaxy

Step into Unyverse, a groundbreaking Afrofuturistic sci-fi action RPG that fuses deep storytelling with fighting game combat. Create your hero and explore a galaxy where African cultures shape the stars, technology meets tradition, and your choices spark consequences that ripple across factions, alliances, and the fate of your homeworld.

As a Mwindaji bounty hunter, your journey will challenge you to fight, trade, and navigate a living world filled with moral complexity, kinetic action, and untold mysteries. Unyverse delivers an experience unlike any RPG before it—where every decision and every battle writes your legend in the stars.

Unyverse is a sci-fi action RPG that fuses story-driven role-playing with the kinetic intensity of fighting games. Created by Afrime Studios, Unyverse invites players into a vibrant Afrofuturistic world where your fists, blades, and choices shape the fate of entire factions.

Key Features

  • Afrofuturism Reimagined:
    Explore a stunning sci-fi world inspired by the African diaspora, where culture, myth, and advanced technology collide in ways never seen in games.

  • Kinetic Fighting Game Combat:
    Master fast, fluid melee combat inspired by fighting games—string combos, counter foes, and unleash devastating finishers in real-time action.

  • Choice-Driven RPG Systems:
    Shape your story through morally complex decisions that impact factions, alliances, and your standing across the galaxy.

  • Online 1v1 PvP with Single-Player Story Impact:
    Enter fierce 1v1 PvP battles using your character and tech tree, where wins boost your reputation in regional arenas—unlocking perks and storylines back in the main game.

  • Be A Mwindaji Bounty Hunter:
    Take on the role of a Mwindaji, an elite bounty hunter whose choices could save or doom their home planet.

  • Freeroam Afrofuturistic Open Zones:
    Discover vast, living regions filled with side quests, rare resources, exotic creatures, and opportunities to trade, hunt, and build your reputation.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 with updates
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X, Intel Core i7-6800K
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT, NVIDIA GeForce 1080
  • Storage: 70 GB available space
